requirements.title: ServiceID named type
requirements.text: The package shall define ServiceID as a named type with underlying type uint16, representing the 16-bit SOME/IP service identifier per AUTOSAR PRS_SOMEIPProtocol §4.1.1; its numeric range shall be 0x0000–0xFFFF.

requirements.title: MethodID named type
requirements.text: The package shall define MethodID as a named type with underlying type uint16, representing the 16-bit SOME/IP method/event identifier per AUTOSAR PRS_SOMEIPProtocol §4.1.1; its numeric range shall be 0x0000–0xFFFF.

requirements.title: ClientID named type
requirements.text: The package shall define ClientID as a named type with underlying type uint16, representing the 16-bit SOME/IP client identifier per AUTOSAR PRS_SOMEIPProtocol §4.1.1; its numeric range shall be 0x0000–0xFFFF.

requirements.title: SessionID named type
requirements.text: The package shall define SessionID as a named type with underlying type uint16, representing the 16-bit SOME/IP session identifier per AUTOSAR PRS_SOMEIPProtocol §4.1.1; its numeric range shall be 0x0000–0xFFFF.

requirements.title: InstanceID named type
requirements.text: The package shall define InstanceID as a named type with underlying type uint16, representing the 16-bit SOME/IP instance identifier per AUTOSAR PRS_SOMEIPProtocol §4.1.1; its numeric range shall be 0x0000–0xFFFF.

requirements.title: EventID named type alias
requirements.text: The package shall define EventID as a type alias for MethodID; by AUTOSAR convention event identifiers have bit 15 set (range 0x8000–0xFFFF), though the type itself imposes no range restriction.

requirements.title: SOME/IP MessageType constants
requirements.text: The package shall define the MessageType enumeration with values Request (0x00), RequestNoReturn (0x01), Notification (0x02), Response (0x80), Error (0x81), and their SOME/IP-TP variants (bit 5 set): TPRequest (0x20), TPRequestNoReturn (0x21), TPNotification (0x22), TPResponse (0xA0), TPError (0xA1), per AUTOSAR PRS_SOMEIPProtocol Table 4-4.

requirements.title: SOME/IP ReturnCode constants
requirements.text: The package shall define the ReturnCode enumeration with values OK (0x00), NotOK (0x01), UnknownService (0x02), UnknownMethod (0x03), NotReady (0x04), NotReachable (0x05), Timeout (0x06), WrongProtocolVersion (0x07), WrongInterfaceVersion (0x08), MalformedMessage (0x09), and WrongMessageType (0x0A) per AUTOSAR PRS_SOMEIPProtocol Table 4-6.

requirements.title: SOME/IP Message struct
requirements.text: The package shall define a Message struct carrying all SOME/IP header fields (ServiceID, MethodID, ClientID, SessionID, ProtocolVersion, InterfaceVersion, MessageType, ReturnCode) and a Payload byte slice containing the application payload only, with no SOME/IP header bytes.

requirements.title: ErrClosed sentinel error
requirements.text: The package shall define ErrClosed as a non-nil, sentinel error value comparable via errors.Is, returned whenever an operation is attempted on a closed Service, Server, or Subscription.

requirements.title: ErrTimeout sentinel error
requirements.text: The package shall define ErrTimeout as a non-nil, sentinel error value comparable via errors.Is, returned when a Service.Call does not receive a response within the configured deadline.

requirements.title: ErrNotReady sentinel error
requirements.text: The package shall define ErrNotReady as a non-nil, sentinel error value comparable via errors.Is, returned when an operation is called before the service is initialised or when a feature is not supported by the transport.

requirements.title: ErrUnknownMethod sentinel error
requirements.text: The package shall define ErrUnknownMethod as a non-nil, sentinel error value comparable via errors.Is, returned when a method ID is invoked that has no registered handler on the server.

requirements.title: ErrUnknownService sentinel error
requirements.text: The package shall define ErrUnknownService as a non-nil, sentinel error value comparable via errors.Is, returned when the requested service/instance cannot be found on the transport.

requirements.title: ErrMalformedMessage sentinel error
requirements.text: The package shall define ErrMalformedMessage as a non-nil, sentinel error value comparable via errors.Is, returned when a received wire frame cannot be decoded into a valid Message.

requirements.title: MethodHandler function type
requirements.text: The package shall define MethodHandler as the type func(ctx context.Context, req Message) ([]byte, error), representing a server-side handler invoked for each incoming method request.

requirements.title: Server interface
requirements.text: The package shall define Server as an interface with three methods: RegisterMethod(methodID MethodID, handler MethodHandler) error, Emit(eventID EventID, payload []byte) error, and Close() error; all implementations shall be safe for concurrent use.

requirements.title: Handler error causes Error response
requirements.text: When a MethodHandler returns a non-nil error the transport shall send a SOME/IP Error message (MessageType=0x81) in place of the normal Response, preserving the original ClientID and SessionID for correlation.

requirements.title: Service.Call — request/response invocation
requirements.text: Service.Call shall send a SOME/IP Request message for methodID with the given payload, block until a matching Response or Error is received, and return the response message; it shall return ErrTimeout if no response arrives within the configured deadline and ErrClosed if the service is closed.

requirements.title: Service.CallNoReturn — fire-and-forget invocation
requirements.text: Service.CallNoReturn shall send a SOME/IP RequestNoReturn message for methodID with the given payload and return without waiting for a response; it shall return ErrClosed if the service is closed.

requirements.title: Service.Subscribe — event subscription
requirements.text: Service.Subscribe shall create a Subscription for the given eventID, returning a Subscription whose C() channel delivers subsequent Notification messages for that event; it shall return ErrClosed if the service is closed.

requirements.title: SubscribeConfig and SubscribeOption
requirements.text: The package shall define SubscribeConfig with a ChannelDepth field controlling delivery channel capacity, SubscribeOption as a functional option type, WithChannelDepth as a constructor, and ApplySubscribeOpts to merge options; zero ChannelDepth shall resolve to a transport-specific default.

requirements.title: Subscription interface
requirements.text: The Subscription interface shall provide C() <-chan Message returning the event delivery channel, Unsubscribe() error removing the subscription without closing the channel, and Close() error unsubscribing and closing the channel; all methods shall be safe for concurrent use and idempotent.

requirements.title: SOME/IP frame encoding
requirements.text: codec.Encode shall serialise a Message into a SOME/IP wire frame per AUTOSAR PRS_SOMEIPProtocol §4.1.1: a 16-byte header (ServiceID, MethodID, Length, ClientID, SessionID, ProtocolVersion, InterfaceVersion, MessageType, ReturnCode) followed by the Payload bytes; the Length field shall equal 8 + len(Payload).

requirements.title: SOME/IP frame decoding
requirements.text: codec.Decode shall parse a byte slice into a Message, verifying the frame is at least HeaderSize bytes long and that the Length field is consistent with the actual frame length; it shall return ErrMalformedMessage for frames that do not satisfy these constraints.

requirements.title: Mock Bus type
requirements.text: mock.Bus shall provide an in-process SOME/IP transport that routes messages between Server and Service instances without any network socket, enabling deterministic unit tests with zero external dependencies.

requirements.title: mock.NewBus constructor
requirements.text: mock.NewBus shall return a new, idle Bus; the bus shall become active and route messages as soon as a Server is registered via NewServer.

requirements.title: mock.NewServer constructor
requirements.text: mock.NewServer shall attach a new in-process Server to the given Bus; all method calls addressed to the server's ServiceID shall be dispatched to registered handlers without copying through any OS buffer.

requirements.title: mock Server.RegisterMethod
requirements.text: mock Server.RegisterMethod shall register handler for methodID, replacing any previous handler for the same ID, and return ErrClosed when the server is closed.

requirements.title: mock Server.Emit
requirements.text: mock Server.Emit shall deliver the payload as a Notification message to all Subscription channels subscribed to eventID; it shall return ErrClosed when the server is closed.

requirements.title: mock Server.Close
requirements.text: mock Server.Close shall close all open subscription channels, prevent further method registration and event emission, and be idempotent when called multiple times.

requirements.title: mock Service.Call
requirements.text: mock Service.Call shall invoke the registered handler for methodID on the Bus's Server and return the handler's response payload; it shall return ErrTimeout when no response arrives within the configured deadline.

requirements.title: mock Service.CallNoReturn
requirements.text: mock Service.CallNoReturn shall dispatch a RequestNoReturn to the Bus's Server and return immediately without waiting for a response; it shall return ErrClosed when the service is closed.

requirements.title: mock Service.Subscribe
requirements.text: mock Service.Subscribe shall return a Subscription whose channel receives Notification messages emitted by any Server on the Bus for eventID; it shall return ErrClosed when the service is closed.

requirements.title: mock Service.Close
requirements.text: mock Service.Close shall close all subscriptions created by this service instance and prevent further calls; it shall be idempotent when called multiple times.

requirements.title: mock subscription.C
requirements.text: mock subscription.C shall return the read-only channel on which event messages are delivered; the channel shall be closed when the subscription or its owning service is closed.

requirements.title: mock subscription.Unsubscribe
requirements.text: mock subscription.Unsubscribe shall remove the subscription from the event fan-out list so that no further messages are delivered; the channel returned by C shall remain open.

requirements.title: mock subscription.Close
requirements.text: mock subscription.Close shall unsubscribe and close the delivery channel; calling Close more than once shall be safe and shall not close the channel a second time.

requirements.title: SOME/IP-SD Entry struct
requirements.text: sd.Entry shall represent a single SOME/IP-SD directory entry per AUTOSAR PRS_SOMEIPServiceDiscovery §4.1.2.2, carrying Type, Index1, Index2, NumOpts1, NumOpts2, ServiceID, InstanceID, MajorVersion, TTL, MinorVersion (Offer/Find), and EventgroupID (Subscribe/SubscribeAck).

requirements.title: sd.EncodeEntry — entry serialisation
requirements.text: sd.EncodeEntry shall serialise an Entry into exactly EntrySize (16) bytes appended to dst, encoding ServiceID and InstanceID as big-endian uint16, TTL as 3-byte big-endian, and MinorVersion or EventgroupID in the lower 4 bytes according to the entry Type field.

requirements.title: sd.DecodeEntry — entry deserialisation
requirements.text: sd.DecodeEntry shall parse the first EntrySize bytes of b into an Entry; it shall return ErrShortEntry when len(b) < EntrySize and ErrUnknownEntryType when the Type byte is not one of Find (0x00), Offer (0x01), Subscribe (0x06), or SubscribeAck (0x07).

requirements.title: SOME/IP-SD IPv4EndpointOption
requirements.text: sd.IPv4EndpointOption shall represent a SOME/IP-SD IPv4 endpoint option per AUTOSAR PRS_SOMEIPServiceDiscovery §4.1.2.3, carrying an IPv4 address (net.IP), Protocol (0x11=UDP or 0x06=TCP), and Port; EncodeIPv4Option and DecodeIPv4Option shall serialise and parse the 12-byte on-wire form.

requirements.title: sd.NewRegistry constructor
requirements.text: sd.NewRegistry shall return an empty in-process service registry that does not require any network sockets, enabling unit tests to exercise SD logic without OS resources.

requirements.title: sd.Registry.Offer
requirements.text: sd.Registry.Offer shall store a ServiceRecord keyed by (ServiceID, InstanceID) with an expiry of time.Now() + TTL seconds; when TTL is zero it shall remove the existing entry (StopOffer semantics); the method shall be safe for concurrent use.

requirements.title: sd.Registry.Find
requirements.text: sd.Registry.Find shall return all non-expired ServiceRecords matching serviceID; passing 0xFFFF shall match all services; it shall not return records whose Expires time is in the past; the method shall be safe for concurrent use.

requirements.title: sdudp.encodeSDFrame — SD wire frame builder
requirements.text: encodeSDFrame shall construct a complete SOME/IP-SD wire frame: a SOME/IP header with ServiceID=0xFFFF and MethodID=0x8100, followed by the SD payload (Flags byte, 3 reserved bytes, 4-byte Entries Length, encoded entry, 4-byte Options Length, optional IPv4 endpoint option), appended to dst.

requirements.title: sdudp.decodeSDPayload — SD payload parser
requirements.text: decodeSDPayload shall parse the SD payload from a SOME/IP-SD frame body: it shall read the Flags byte, Entries Length, all SD entries (each 16 bytes), and validate that the declared lengths are consistent with the actual slice length, returning ErrMalformedMessage on any inconsistency.

requirements.title: sdudp.Daemon type
requirements.text: sdudp.Daemon shall implement a SOME/IP-SD agent that binds to a UDP multicast group, sends periodic OfferService announcements, receives FindService queries, and updates an in-process sd.Registry when OfferService messages arrive from remote peers.

requirements.title: sdudp.NewDaemon constructor
requirements.text: sdudp.NewDaemon shall create a Daemon: resolve the multicast address from cfg.MulticastAddr (default 239.192.255.251:30490), bind a UDP socket, join the multicast group, start the readLoop goroutine, and return the Daemon; it shall return an error if any network operation fails.

requirements.title: sdudp.Daemon.Registry
requirements.text: sdudp.Daemon.Registry shall return the Daemon's live sd.Registry, which is updated asynchronously whenever a remote OfferService or StopOfferService message is received on the multicast socket.

requirements.title: sdudp.Daemon.Offer
requirements.text: sdudp.Daemon.Offer shall register a service and start a goroutine that sends periodic OfferService announcements at cfg.OfferInterval (default 1s); calling Offer with the same key as an existing offer shall replace the existing offer goroutine after sending a StopOffer for the old configuration.

requirements.title: sdudp.Daemon.Find
requirements.text: sdudp.Daemon.Find shall transmit a FindService entry for serviceID on the multicast group; responses from remote peers are applied to the Registry asynchronously by the readLoop goroutine.

requirements.title: sdudp.Daemon.Close
requirements.text: sdudp.Daemon.Close shall stop all offer ticker goroutines, send a StopOffer (TTL=0) for each registered service, close the UDP socket, and wait for the readLoop to exit; subsequent calls shall be no-ops; it shall be safe for concurrent use.

requirements.title: sdudp.Daemon.SubscribeEventgroup
requirements.text: sdudp.Daemon.SubscribeEventgroup shall send a SubscribeEventgroup entry to the given serverAddr; the calling goroutine shall block until an Ack is received or the context is cancelled; it shall return ErrClosed when the Daemon is closed.

requirements.title: udp.NewServer constructor
requirements.text: udp.NewServer shall bind a UDP socket at cfg.Addr, start a readLoop goroutine, and return a Server ready to receive SOME/IP frames; it shall return an error if the address cannot be resolved or the socket cannot be bound.

requirements.title: udp.Server.RegisterMethod
requirements.text: udp.Server.RegisterMethod shall register handler for methodID, replacing any previous handler for the same ID, and return ErrClosed when the server is closed.

requirements.title: udp.Server unknown method response
requirements.text: udp.Server shall respond with a SOME/IP Error frame carrying ReturnCode=UnknownMethod when a Request arrives for a methodID that has no registered handler.

requirements.title: udp.Server.Close
requirements.text: udp.Server.Close shall close the UDP socket, wait for the readLoop to exit via WaitGroup, and return any error from the underlying socket close; subsequent calls shall be no-ops.

requirements.title: udp.NewService constructor
requirements.text: udp.NewService shall resolve cfg.ServerAddr, bind an ephemeral local UDP socket, start a readLoop goroutine, and return a Service ready to send SOME/IP requests; it shall return an error if the address cannot be resolved or the socket cannot be bound.

requirements.title: udp.Service.Call — request/response
requirements.text: udp.Service.Call shall send a SOME/IP Request with an auto-incremented SessionID, register a pending channel, and block until the matching Response or Error arrives; it shall return ErrTimeout if no response arrives within the configured deadline, ErrClosed if the service is closed, or ctx.Err() if the context is cancelled.

requirements.title: udp.Service.CallNoReturn
requirements.text: udp.Service.CallNoReturn shall send a SOME/IP RequestNoReturn frame and return immediately without waiting for a response; it shall return ErrClosed when the service is closed.

requirements.title: udp.Service.Subscribe
requirements.text: udp.Service.Subscribe shall register a buffered channel in the event fan-out map for eventID using a CAS loop safe for concurrent callers; it shall return ErrClosed when the service is closed.

requirements.title: udp.Service.Close
requirements.text: udp.Service.Close shall close the UDP socket, wait for the readLoop to exit, and return any error from the underlying socket close; subsequent calls shall be no-ops.

requirements.title: udp subscription.C
requirements.text: udp subscription.C shall return the read-only channel on which Notification messages for the subscribed eventID are delivered.

requirements.title: udp subscription.Unsubscribe
requirements.text: udp subscription.Unsubscribe shall remove this subscription's channel from the fan-out list so that no further messages are delivered; the channel returned by C shall remain open.

requirements.title: udp subscription.Close
requirements.text: udp subscription.Close shall call Unsubscribe and then close the delivery channel exactly once, using sync.Once to guarantee idempotent closure; subsequent calls shall be no-ops.

requirements.title: tcp.NewServer constructor
requirements.text: tcp.NewServer shall listen on a TCP socket at cfg.Addr, start an accept loop, and return a Server ready to receive connections; it shall return an error if the address cannot be resolved or the listener cannot be created.

requirements.title: tcp.Server.RegisterMethod
requirements.text: tcp.Server.RegisterMethod shall register handler for methodID, replacing any previous handler for the same ID; it shall return ErrClosed when the server is closed.

requirements.title: tcp.Server method dispatch
requirements.text: tcp.Server shall dispatch each inbound SOME/IP Request to the registered MethodHandler for its methodID over the per-connection serveConn goroutine; the response shall be written back on the same TCP connection.

requirements.title: tcp.Server unknown method response
requirements.text: tcp.Server shall respond with a SOME/IP Error frame carrying ReturnCode=UnknownMethod when a Request arrives for a methodID that has no registered handler.

requirements.title: tcp.Server handler-error response
requirements.text: tcp.Server shall respond with a SOME/IP Error frame (MessageType=0x81) when the invoked MethodHandler returns a non-nil error, preserving the original ClientID and SessionID for correlation.

requirements.title: tcp.Server.Emit — no-op for TCP
requirements.text: tcp.Server.Emit shall return nil without sending any frame; TCP has no multicast delivery path, so event emission is not supported by the TCP transport.

requirements.title: tcp.Server.Close
requirements.text: tcp.Server.Close shall close the TCP listener, stopping the accept loop; subsequent calls shall be no-ops returning nil.

requirements.title: tcp.NewService constructor
requirements.text: tcp.NewService shall establish a TCP connection to cfg.ServerAddr within the configured dial timeout, start a read goroutine, and return a Service; it shall return an error if the connection cannot be established.

requirements.title: tcp.Service.Call — request/response with SessionID demux
requirements.text: tcp.Service.Call shall send a SOME/IP Request over the TCP connection with an auto-incremented SessionID, register a pending channel keyed by SessionID, and return the matching Response or Error when it arrives; concurrent calls shall be demuxed correctly by SessionID.

requirements.title: tcp.Service.Call — context cancellation
requirements.text: tcp.Service.Call shall return ctx.Err() (context.Canceled or context.DeadlineExceeded) when the supplied context is cancelled or its deadline expires before a response is received.

requirements.title: tcp.Service.Call — timeout
requirements.text: tcp.Service.Call shall return ErrTimeout when the configured per-service timeout expires before a response is received.

requirements.title: tcp.Service.CallNoReturn
requirements.text: tcp.Service.CallNoReturn shall send a SOME/IP RequestNoReturn frame over the TCP connection and return immediately without waiting for a response; it shall return ErrClosed if the service is closed.

requirements.title: tcp.Service.Subscribe — not supported
requirements.text: tcp.Service.Subscribe shall return ErrNotReady; TCP transport does not support event subscription in this implementation.

requirements.title: tcp.Service.Close
requirements.text: tcp.Service.Close shall close the TCP connection; any pending Call shall return ErrClosed; subsequent Close calls shall be no-ops; the service shall be safe for concurrent use.

requirements.title: E2E Profile01 type
requirements.text: e2e.Profile01 shall implement AUTOSAR E2E Protection Profile 01 per AUTOSAR PRS_E2EProtocol §6.3, using CRC-8/SAE-J1850 (polynomial 0x1D, init 0xFF, XOR-out 0xFF) with a 2-byte header: byte 0 = CRC, byte 1 = (DataID[0] & 0xF0) | (counter & 0x0F).

requirements.title: e2e.NewProfile01 constructor
requirements.text: e2e.NewProfile01 shall return a Profile01 configured with the given 16-bit DataID; the DataID shall be folded into the CRC computation for all Protect and Check operations to detect message substitution.

requirements.title: Profile01.Protect — E2E header injection
requirements.text: Profile01.Protect shall prepend a 2-byte E2E header to payload and return the protected frame; the CRC shall cover DataID[0], DataID[1], header byte 1, and all payload bytes; counter must be in [0,14] — value 15 is reserved by AUTOSAR and shall return ErrInvalidCounter.

requirements.title: Profile01.Check — E2E verification
requirements.text: Profile01.Check shall verify the 2-byte header in frame: it shall recompute the CRC over DataID bytes and payload and compare with the received CRC byte, returning ErrCRCMismatch on mismatch; it shall compare the counter nibble with expectedCounter & 0x0F, returning ErrCounterMismatch on mismatch; it shall return ErrShortFrame when len(frame) < 2.

requirements.title: E2E Profile05 type
requirements.text: e2e.Profile05 shall implement AUTOSAR E2E Protection Profile 05 per AUTOSAR PRS_E2EProtocol §6.7, using CRC-32/Ethernet (reflected polynomial 0xEDB88320, init 0xFFFFFFFF, XOR-out 0xFFFFFFFF) with an 8-byte header: bytes 0–3 = CRC-32 LE, byte 4 = counter (0–255), bytes 5–7 = reserved (0x00).

requirements.title: e2e.NewProfile05 constructor
requirements.text: e2e.NewProfile05 shall return a Profile05 configured with the given 8-bit DataID; the DataID shall be prepended to the CRC input to detect message substitution.

requirements.title: Profile05.Protect — E2E header injection
requirements.text: Profile05.Protect shall prepend an 8-byte E2E header to payload and return the protected frame; the CRC-32 shall cover DataID, header bytes 4–7 (counter + reserved), and all payload bytes; bytes 5–7 of the header shall be 0x00 (reserved).

requirements.title: Profile05.Check — E2E verification
requirements.text: Profile05.Check shall verify the 8-byte header in frame: it shall recompute the CRC-32 over DataID, counter byte, reserved bytes, and payload and compare with the received CRC-32 (little-endian), returning ErrCRCMismatch on mismatch; it shall compare the counter byte with expectedCounter, returning ErrCounterMismatch on mismatch; it shall return ErrShortFrame when len(frame) < 8.

requirements.title: tp.Segment — TP frame construction
requirements.text: tp.Segment shall split msg.Payload into TP-framed messages per AUTOSAR PRS_SOMEIPProtocol §7.1.7; each segment shall prepend a 4-byte TP header encoding the payload byte offset in 16-byte units (bits 31:4) and the More flag (bit 0); the MessageType shall have bit 5 set (TP bit).

requirements.title: tp.Segment — pass-through for small payloads
requirements.text: tp.Segment shall return the input message unmodified (without TP framing) when len(msg.Payload) <= segmentSize; the returned slice shall contain exactly one element.

requirements.title: tp.Segment — ErrSegmentTooLarge
requirements.text: tp.Segment shall return ErrSegmentTooLarge when segmentSize < 16; segment sizes below 16 bytes cannot encode a valid TP offset in 16-byte units.

requirements.title: tp.IsTP — TP bit detection
requirements.text: tp.IsTP shall return true when bit 5 (0x20) of msg.MessageType is set, indicating SOME/IP-TP framing, and false otherwise.

requirements.title: tp.BaseMessageType — TP bit stripping
requirements.text: tp.BaseMessageType shall return the MessageType with bit 5 (the TP bit) cleared, mapping TP variants back to their base message types (e.g. TPRequest→Request, TPResponse→Response).

requirements.title: tp.Reassembler type
requirements.text: tp.Reassembler shall collect SOME/IP-TP segments keyed by (ServiceID, MethodID, SessionID), tracking received byte ranges and emitting the complete reassembled message once all segments have arrived; it shall be safe for concurrent use from multiple goroutines.

requirements.title: tp.NewReassembler constructor
requirements.text: tp.NewReassembler shall create a Reassembler with the configured Timeout (default 5 s) and GCInterval (default Timeout/2), starting a background gcLoop goroutine that evicts expired assembly windows.

requirements.title: tp.Reassembler.Add — non-TP pass-through
requirements.text: tp.Reassembler.Add shall return the input message immediately (without buffering) when the message does not have the TP bit set.

requirements.title: tp.Reassembler.Add — ErrMalformedSegment
requirements.text: tp.Reassembler.Add shall return ErrMalformedSegment when the TP-flagged message payload is shorter than the 4-byte TP header.

requirements.title: tp.Reassembler.Add — segment collection and reassembly
requirements.text: tp.Reassembler.Add shall buffer TP segments keyed by (ServiceID, MethodID, SessionID) and return the complete reassembled message (with TP bit cleared) when all byte ranges have been received and contiguous; out-of-order arrival shall be handled correctly.

requirements.title: tp.Reassembler.Add — ErrReassemblyTimeout
requirements.text: tp.Reassembler.Add shall return ErrReassemblyTimeout when a segment arrives for a (ServiceID, MethodID, SessionID) key whose assembly window has expired; this shall hold whether the expiry is detected inline or via the tombstone left by the background gcLoop.

requirements.title: tp.Reassembler.Add — duplicate segment handling
requirements.text: tp.Reassembler.Add shall silently ignore duplicate segments (same byte offset for the same key) and shall complete reassembly correctly when non-duplicate segments complete the window.

requirements.title: tp.Reassembler.Close
requirements.text: tp.Reassembler.Close shall stop the GC ticker, signal the gcLoop to exit, and discard all pending assembly windows and tombstones; Close shall be callable at most once without panic.
